about: Linear radiance (red channel) of a white Lambertian plane (albedo 1) under one light, measured with Blender 5.2.0 Cycles (2048 samples, direct light only, filter width 0.01: pixel centres) by research/2026-10-stage19/blender/e3_lights/blender_lights.py; images are 33 x 33 top views, rows from the top. Setups: suns 1 W/m^2 straight down; points and spots 1000 W, 2 m up (spots 60 deg, blend 0 / 0.3); areas 100 W, 1 m up facing down, 0.5 m (x 1 m for rectangle and ellipse); ortho scales 8 (point profile) and 4 (spot, area).
